C1.worst_defect: On the phone header only 'Docs' and 'Live demo' show; 'Quick start' and 'For cashiers: At the till' are behind the chevron or below the hero, so a shop owner checking between customers has to scroll to find the page their staff need.

C2.worst_defect: The demo row says 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie' without saying who ph.wcpos.com is, so an unexplained third-party domain shows up on a VendurePOS page; quick-start also carries a collapsed 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' note about an old domain nobody introduced.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.03 ('Live demo or your own store' table); quick-start.desktop.02

C3.worst_defect: For an own store, a refund is 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup', so the owner learns that closing out a refund needs the freelance developer every time, with no counter-side wording of who does what.
C3.where: home.desktop.02 table refund row; at-the-till.desktop.03 'Refund a sale' step 1 ('Plugin setup has the steps for them')

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting mixes counter staff, store owner and server admin on one page: 'When till updates need attention' tells the owner to 'copy the refused line from this till's sync log, and match its errorCode', hides how under a collapsed 'To find the line in the sync log', and goes straight on to GraphQL tallyNeedsAdminCommands / tallyResolveNeedsAdmin and VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP.

C5.worst_defect: On at-the-till the small cashier-sheet and closure screenshots sit centred in wide empty bands of the content column, and the cashier-sheet image differs between desktop and phone (phone shows 'Last synced 10:07 PM / Sync now'), which reads as two different tills.

C6.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet image on the phone has a grey vertical stripe down its left edge, and the till guide runs to many slices, so a cashier looking up 'If the internet drops' or 'close the day' on a phone scrolls a long way past the Jump-to links.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse mobile still lists failing audits on the home page: 'Reduce unused JavaScript' (~53 KiB), render-blocking requests (~150 ms) and ~14 KiB legacy JavaScript; everything else (titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, og image, llms.txt, sitemap, search API, helpful 404) is in place.

overall_worst.defect: When something goes wrong at the counter, Troubleshooting hands the shop owner developer material ('copy the refused line from this till's sync log, and match its errorCode', a collapsed sync-log how-to, GraphQL tallyNeedsAdminCommands) instead of a short 'what staff do now, what to tell your developer' answer.
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 / troubleshooting.phone.01, section 'When till updates need attention'
overall_worst.fix: Open that section with a two-line 'At the counter' box (keep selling, keep the printed Z report, tell your developer the code shown) and move errorCode matching and the GraphQL calls under a 'For your developer' sub-heading.
